messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a **complete list of the Canadian federal public holidays that create a “long weekend” (i.e., a three‑day weekend) in 2023**.  
(If a holiday falls on a weekend, the statutory “observed” day is usually the following Monday, which is the day that actually gives you the extra day off.)

| Date (2023) | Holiday | Day of Week | Observed (if applicable) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|-------------|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1** | New Year’s Day | Sunday | – | **Jan 1–3** (Sun‑Mon‑Tue) | Monday Jan 2 is the statutory “observed” day. |
| **Feb 20** | Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON) | Monday | – | **Feb 18–20** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | Only in the provinces listed above. |
| **Apr 7** | Good Friday | Friday | – | **Apr 7–9** (Fri‑Sat‑Sun) | |
| **May 22** | Victoria Day | Monday | – | **May 20–22** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| **Jul 1** | Canada Day | Saturday | Observed Jul 3 | **Jul 1–3** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| **Sep 4** | Labour Day | Monday | – | **Sep 2–4** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| **Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Monday | – | **Oct 7–9** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| **Nov 11** | Remembrance Day | Saturday | Observed Nov 13 | **Nov 11–13** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| **Dec 25** | Christmas Day | Monday | – | **Dec 23–25** (Sat‑Sun‑Mon) | |
| **Dec 26** | Boxing Day | Tuesday | – | – | Not a long weekend (unless combined with Christmas). |

### How to Use This List

1. **Plan Your Trips** – The “Long‑Weekend Span” column shows the three‑day stretch you’ll have off.  
2. **Check Provincial Variations** – If you’re traveling within a specific province, add any provincial holidays that also create long weekends (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador, etc.).  
3. **Verify with Official Sources** – For the most accurate and up‑to‑date information, consult the Government of Canada’s public holiday calendar or your provincial government’s holiday page.

### Quick Reference (by Month)

| Month | Long‑Weekend Holidays (2023) |
|-------|------------------------------|
| January | New Year’s Day (Jan 1–3) |
| February | Family Day (Feb 18–20) – only in BC, AB, SK, NB, ON |
| April | Good Friday (Apr 7–9) |
| May | Victoria Day (May 20–22) |
| July | Canada Day (Jul 1–3) |
| September | Labour Day (Sep 2–4) |
| October | Thanksgiving (Oct 7–9) |
| November | Remembrance Day (Nov 11–13) |
| December | Christmas Day (Dec 23–25) |

---

#### Quick Links for Further Detail

- **Government of Canada – Public Holidays**: https://www.canada.ca/en/services/benefits/public-service.html  
- **Provincial Holiday Calendars** (example):  
  - Ontario: https://www.ontario.ca/page/ontario-public-holidays  
  - British Columbia: https://www.gov.bc.ca/gov/content/governments/technology-innovation/holiday-calendar  

Feel free to copy the table into your holiday‑planning app or use it as a reference for scheduling your long‑weekend getaways!
